name: loop-lift
prompt: A soft woven fabric loop being lifted off a brass peg: gentle cloth rustle ending in a light metallic tick, close-miked, dry studio recording.

name: loop-lower
prompt: A soft fabric loop settling back down onto a wooden peg: muted cloth flop with a faint woody knock, quiet and dry.

name: loop-place
prompt: A yarn loop dropped onto a brass peg: soft fabric thud followed by a short delicate metal ring, single clean take.

name: loop-settle
prompt: Alternate take of a yarn loop landing on a peg: gentler cotton whump with a low brass ping, slightly softer than a firm placement.

name: move-denied
prompt: A dull muted double knock on a wooden loom frame signaling refusal: two short low thuds, no ringing, dry and flat.

name: peg-complete
prompt: A bright small bell chime with a sparkle of glass beads as one peg is finished: cheerful ascending shimmer, one clean hit with a short tail.

name: loom-finished
prompt: A short triumphant bell arpeggio rising through four notes with a warm glockenspiel shimmer and a gentle fabric swish underneath, celebratory but cozy.

name: round-over
prompt: A soft descending two-note sigh on a muted wooden marimba with a faint cloth rustle, calm and slightly disappointed, no harshness.

name: move-undone
prompt: A quick reverse whoosh of fabric being pulled backward with a soft upward metallic flick, like a thread being unwound from a spool.

name: hint-chime
prompt: A single soft glass ping with a gentle shimmering tail, like a fingertip tapped on a small crystal glass, friendly and unobtrusive.

name: ui-click
prompt: A short crisp wooden toggle click, like a small loom shuttle switch being flipped, very brief and dry.

name: achievement-unlock
prompt: A small two-bell fanfare with a bright metallic sparkle and a soft felt mallet hit, like a tiny award ribbon being pinned, warm and rewarding.
